scenes.scene_purpose: Introduce title, copyright, and cosmic creation animation.

prev_boundary.evidence: Video starts with black screen and text.

visual_segments.action: Black screen displays Creative Commons license info.
Text 'Your Name Here presents' appears over blue waves.
Text changes to 'in association with Your Money'.
Sita's head rises from water, then full body on lotus.
Ornate gramophone rises on lotus next to Sita.
Sita dances as gramophone plays record.
Sita continues dancing, background shifts to particles.
Particle explosion reveals 'Sita Sings the Blues' title.
Credits show 'a film by Nina Paley'.

scenes.scene_purpose: Show Hindu deities and universe creation.

visual_segments.action: Four-faced Brahma sits on lotus holding flower.
Blue Vishnu lies on serpent, Sita massages feet.
Lotus grows from Vishnu's navel, Brahma sits on it.
Moon god chariot shown, Sita's heart beats visibly.
Heart animation surrounded by lotuses, Brahma reappears.
Earth held by deities, zoom into continents.
Earth fills screen, transitions to solid blue.
Text 'SAN FRANCISCO' over city animation.
Couple sleeping in bed, cat at foot.
Cat wakes up, yawns, stretches.
Cat walks to empty food bowl, meows.
Cat jumps on bed, yells at woman, she wakes.

scenes.scene_purpose: Show modern couple's routine, transition to epic backstory.

prev_boundary.evidence: Woman gets up to feed cat.

visual_segments.action: Woman feeds cat in kitchen, cat eats.
Woman returns to bed, couple kisses, sleeps.
Woman reads on sofa, man uses laptop on floor.
Man looks at woman, she ignores him, cat plays.
Text 'India A Long Time Ago' with shadow puppets.
Shadow puppets show centuries (14th, 4th, BC).
Map shows Ayodhya, Ramayana book vs Bible.
Dasharatha and three queens introduced.

scenes.scene_purpose: Introduce main characters and exile plot.

visual_segments.action: Sita introduced as Janak's daughter, wedding to Rama.
Dasharatha crowns Rama, Kaikeyi objects.
Kaikeyi demands exile, king collapses.
King dies, Bharat refuses throne, Rama exiled.
Rama, Sita, Laxman prepare for forest.
Three walk through forest path.
Life in forest, demons appear.
Rama fights purple one-eyed demons.

scenes.scene_purpose: Rama's victory, cut to modern breakup.

visual_segments.action: Rama defeats demons, embraces Sita.
Rama and Sita dance among defeated demons.
Airport chaos, couple hugs in crowd.
Couple kisses, man leaves with luggage.
Text 'Ravana', ten-headed demon shown.
Surpanakha rejected by Rama, nose cut.
Surpanakha complains to Ravana, he plans kidnapping.
Ravana transforms into Golden Deer.

scenes.scene_purpose: Ravana lures Rama away, kidnaps Sita.

visual_segments.action: Sita spots Golden Deer, asks Rama to catch it.
Rama chases deer, Ravana approaches hut.
Ravana grabs Sita, she drops jewelry.
Ravana flies with Sita to Lanka castle.
Rama returns, finds Sita gone, meets Hanuman.
Hanuman promises help, leaps across ocean.
Hanuman arrives in Lanka, sees guarded Sita.
Hanuman gives Rama's ring to Sita.

scenes.scene_title: Hanuman Burns Lanka & Modern Phone Call
scenes.scene_purpose: Hanuman sets Lanka on fire; modern couple breaks up via phone.

prev_boundary.evidence: Hanuman captured and tail set on fire.

visual_segments.action: Demons set Hanuman's tail on fire, he grows larger.
Hanuman uses burning tail to set Lanka castle ablaze.
Hanuman leaps back across ocean to Rama.
Modern Woman wakes to phone call from Modern Man.
Couple argues on phone, Woman cries.
Man in tropical room hangs up; Woman sobs in bed.

prev_boundary.evidence: Back to epic, Sita refuses Ravana.

visual_segments.action: Sita rejects Ravana's advances in Ashoka grove.
Ravana threatens Sita with sword, she remains defiant.

scenes.scene_purpose: Sita prays for rescue; Rama builds bridge to Lanka.

visual_segments.action: Sita meditates under tree, thinking of Rama.
Hanuman reassures Sita that Rama is coming.
Monkey army builds stone bridge across ocean.
Rama leads monkey army across the completed bridge.
Monkey army clashes with demon guards at Lanka gates.
Rama shoots arrows at Ravana, who deflects them.
Rama kills Ravana; demons flee, Sita is freed.
Modern Woman packs suitcase in bedroom.

scenes.scene_purpose: Woman travels to India; Sita undergoes Agni Pariksha.

visual_segments.action: Animated map shows flight from SF to Trivandrum, India.
Sita walks into fire to prove purity to Rama.
Agni returns unburnt Sita; Rama accepts her.
Modern Woman navigates crowded Indian street searching.
Woman finds Man, they embrace and kiss passionately.
Man reveals he is married; Woman looks devastated.
Rama banishes pregnant Sita to forest again.
Sita raises twin sons alone in forest hermitage.

scenes.scene_title: Sita's Return to Earth & Modern Loneliness
scenes.scene_purpose: Sita chooses earth over doubt; Woman feels isolated in India.

visual_segments.action: Earth goddess opens ground, Sita descends into it.
Modern Woman sits alone in dim hotel room looking out window.
Woman lies in bed staring at ceiling, unable to sleep.
Woman sits up, looks at moon through window, misses Man.
Woman puts on black bikini, lies back down trying to relax.
Woman shivers, hugs herself tightly for warmth.
Woman curls into fetal position on bed, crying silently.
Screen fades to black, end credits roll over music.

scenes.scene_purpose: Sita reflects on past events in forest; montage of key moments.

visual_segments.action: Sita sits under tree, thought bubble shows Rama and Hanuman.
Thought bubble changes to show Ravana's ten heads menacingly.
Bubble shows hanging noose symbolizing Sita's despair.
Sita shakes head, dispelling dark memories, looks determined.
Shadow Narrator silhouette gestures towards Sita's story.
Shadow figures depict Sita's purity test and exile.
Shadow Narrator bows, fades into background foliage.
Cut to Ravana's throne room, demons celebrating prematurely.

scenes.scene_purpose: Show Ravana's arrogance and his demon forces preparing for war.

visual_segments.action: Ravana laughs maniacally, waving weapons in all hands.
Rows of purple one-eyed demons march in formation.
Demons sharpen spears and axes, preparing for battle.
Ravana addresses army from balcony, pointing towards horizon.
Demon army roars in approval, weapons raised high.

prev_boundary.evidence: Cut to Sita in Ashoka grove.

visual_segments.action: Contrast cut: Sita sitting sadly under tree while demons party.
Demons throw flowers mockingly at Sita, she ignores them.
Sita closes eyes, hands folded in prayer, ignoring chaos.

scenes.scene_purpose: Detailed depiction of the monkey army building the bridge to Lanka.

visual_segments.action: Hanuman lifts massive boulder effortlessly over head.
Monkeys form chain, passing rocks hand-to-hand into water.
Stone path extends further across blue waves towards Lanka.
Rama stands at edge of built section, directing placement.
Last few stones placed, bridge connects to Lanka shore.
Rama steps onto bridge first, followed by Hanuman.
Thousands of monkeys flood across the bridge in orderly lines.
Rama reaches Lanka shore, raises bow signaling attack.

scenes.scene_purpose: Depict the chaotic and violent battle between monkeys and demons.

visual_segments.action: Monkey and demon lines collide with loud impact.
Hanuman smashes three demons with single mace swing.
Rama fires rapid arrows, each hitting a demon precisely.
Demons use magic spells, turning some monkeys to stone temporarily.
Other monkeys break spell, resume fighting fiercely.
Demon ranks begin to thin, monkeys gain ground.
Ravana joins battle personally, wielding giant sword.
Rama and Ravana lock weapons, sparks fly from impact.

scenes.scene_purpose: Climactic defeat of villain and emotional reunion.

visual_segments.action: Rama draws glowing Brahmastra arrow, aiming at Ravana's chest.
Arrow flies in slow motion, piercing Ravana's heart.
Ravana staggers, drops weapons, collapses lifelessly.
Remaining demons drop weapons and flee or kneel.
Rama rushes through ruins to Ashoka grove.
Rama finds Sita, they embrace tightly, tears flowing.
Hanuman approaches, bows deeply to both Rama and Sita.
Pushpaka Vimana (flying chariot) arrives to take them home.

scenes.scene_purpose: Triumphant return and Rama's crowning as king.

visual_segments.action: Ayodhya citizens line streets, throwing flowers and cheering.
Rama and Sita walk through flower-covered path to palace.
Inside palace, elders and Bharat await with crown.
Priest places golden crown on Rama's head.
Sita receives jeweled tiara, standing beside Rama.
Bharat places sandals on throne, symbolizing Rama's true rule.
Rama raises hand, addressing people with promise of justice.
Fade from ancient coronation to modern Woman walking alone at night.

scenes.scene_purpose: Parallel Sita's endurance with modern woman's loneliness.

visual_segments.action: Woman walks down empty Indian street under streetlights.
She enters small hotel lobby, nods tiredly at receptionist.
Opens door to dim room, drops bag on floor heavily.
Stares out window at city lights, reflection visible in glass.
Checks phone screen, no new messages, puts it down sadly.
Slowly removes outer clothes, left in underwear, sits on bed edge.
Face buried in hands, shoulders shaking with silent sobs.
Tears blur vision, scene dissolves into Sita's forest meditation.

scenes.scene_purpose: Sita's spiritual strength inspires modern woman.

visual_segments.action: Sita meditating, aura of golden light surrounds her.
Flowers bloom rapidly around her, animals gather peacefully.
Sita opens eyes, serene smile, unbothered by past trauma.
Light beams from Sita towards viewer (modern woman's POV).
Modern Woman gasps awake in bed, tears dried, expression changed.
She sits up straight, wipes face, looks at mirror with determination.
Dresses confidently, packs bag with purpose, not despair.
Walks out of hotel into morning sunlight, head held high.

scenes.scene_purpose: Woman embraces solo journey, paralleling Sita's self-reliance.

visual_segments.action: Woman explores vibrant local market, touching fabrics, smiling.
Visits ancient temple, observes rituals with respect, not sadness.
Sits on beach watching sunset, peaceful, not lonely.
Writes in journal at cafe, expression focused and content.
Chatting warmly with local women, sharing tea and laughter.
Dances freely in open field, arms wide, joyful abandon.
Takes selfie in mirror, genuine smile, no filter needed.
Montage of her happy moments fades into Sita's final earth return.

scenes.scene_purpose: Sita's ultimate choice and film conclusion.

visual_segments.action: Sita stands before Rama, shakes head refusing second trial.
Ground glows, Mother Earth rises to embrace Sita.
Sita sinks into earth, smiling peacefully, reunited with mother.
Rama watches, tears in eyes, understands her choice.
Modern Woman stands on beach, arms crossed, looking at horizon, content.
Sun sets behind her, silhouette strong and independent.
Black screen with white text credits rolling upwards.
